description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'CommandConsumer' that wraps an AMQP receiver link for consuming commands and includes methods for creating tracing spans and logging received commands, primarily for telemetry and monitoring purposes within an Eclipse Hono client implementation.

classes.name: CommandConsumer
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a wrapper around an AMQP receiver link to consume commands, providing utility methods for tracing and logging command messages.

methods.name: createSpan
methods.description: Creates and starts an OpenTracing span for command consumer operations, tagging it with relevant contextual information such as tenantId, deviceId, and optionally gatewayId.

methods.name: logReceivedCommandToSpan
methods.description: Logs details of a received command to a span, marking it as valid and setting correlation ID, address, reply-to, name, and content type; logs an error if command is invalid.
